section.sectionSummaryBrief: The descent of exile is for the sake of an ascent, where the advantage of light comes from darkness, and the greater the descent, the greater the ascent.
section.t: And it is known that the intent of the descent of exile is for the sake of an ascent.
For specifically through the service during the time of exile will there be the revelation of the future, which is loftier than the revelation that was during the time of the Temple.
And [this is] like the advantage of light from darkness,
that through the darkness an advantage is made in the light,
which is loftier than it was before.
And the more the descent
(the darkness)
is lower,
the ascent
(the advantage of light)
that comes through it,
is more lofty.
And from this it is understood,
that since the descent of exile is primarily in the body
(as above in section 4),
therefore,
the ascent of the future
(which is made through the descent of exile)
that will be in the body is more lofty than the ascent that will be in the soul.
And this will be understood based on what is explained elsewhere
regarding the matter of the ascent of the soul that is made through its descent below,
that there are two matters in this.
First,
that by the fact that even when it is below and clothed in a body and an animal soul it serves G-d,
the strength of its connection with the Holy One, blessed be He, is revealed,
that the concealment and hiding of the body and animal soul cannot nullify it, G-d forbid,
and not even make a diminution in its connection.
Second,
that through the service of the soul below, the refinement and purification of the body, animal soul, and its portion in the world is accomplished.
And the distinction between these two matters is,
that in the first matter – the advantage of light is through the darkness.
And the advantage is,
that through the darkness the strength of the light is revealed,
that even the greatest darkness does not conceal relative to it.
However, in the second matter – the advantage of light is also in the darkness itself,
that the darkness
(of the body, animal soul, and the world)
is turned into light.
And the advantage is,
that in order to turn the darkness into light, it is in the power of the Awtsmoos, which is above the limitations of light and darkness,
and through the transformation of darkness into light,
the power of the Awtsmoos is revealed.
And moreover,
that specifically through this the intent that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,
[for the matter of "desire" is in His Essence].
And as explained in Tanya,
that the intent of the soul's descent below is not for the sake of the soul, but rather in order to rectify the body, animal soul, and its portion in the world,
for specifically through this the intent of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Just as the main ascent from the soul's descent is the refinement of the body, so too in the future the main ascent from exile is in the body, turning its darkness into light.
section.t: And just as it is regarding the ascent through the descent of the soul below,
that the main ascent is the refinement and purification of the body etc.,
so too is it regarding the ascent of the future through the descent of exile,
that the main ascent is in the body.
For the advantage that is made in the soul through the darkness of exile is the revelation of the strength of its connection,
that although it is clothed in a body and the body is in exile, nevertheless even then the soul is not in exile.
And the advantage that is made in the body is that the darkness of the body as it is in exile
(which is a greater darkness than its darkness
as it is in itself)
is turned into light,
and moreover,
that through the fact that even its darkness as it is in exile is turned into light,
the intent of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,
in a lower realm that is lower than which there is none.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In the future, the soul will be nourished from the body, receiving the advantage that comes from the darkness itself, which is not fully achieved now.
section.t: And it is known
that in the future the soul will be nourished from the body.
And based on this, it can be said,
that in the future the soul will have
(not only the advantage made through the darkness,
but rather)
also the advantage that comes from the darkness itself.
For although this advantage will be
(primarily)
in the body,
the soul will also receive this advantage from the body.
And in the manner of what is known
regarding the matter of the ascent made in the soul through its descent below into a body and animal soul,
that in addition to the fact that through the concealment and hiding of the body and animal soul, the hidden powers of the soul are aroused and revealed
(which were also before its descent),
behold, through the soul refining and purifying the body and animal soul,
an advantage and addition is also made in it.
As it is written,
"Draw me after You, let us run,"
that through the divine soul causing that even the animal soul will have love of G-d,
that the love of the animal soul is in a manner of running,
through this "let us run" is also made in the divine soul,
"after You let us run" in the plural.
However now,
since the soul is the influencer and the body is the receiver,
this advantage of the soul
(that it receives from the body)
is not in completeness,
and the completeness of this advantage will be in the future,
since then the soul will be nourished from the body.
